mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a clear 71 degrees with an air quality index of 52, which is slightly elevated. We are under a new moon tonight, and the international space station will be visible starting at 9:08 PM, rising in the west over Mount Horeb and heading toward Madison near the Home Depot for a four-minute pass. Overnight, we expect a low of 64 degrees with no rain predicted.

In city news, the police department reported that on September 10th, officers responded to a burglary in progress at the 600 block of Hunters Cove Way, where a suspect was apprehended with a handgun. Additionally, election notices for the upcoming November general election have been posted, and the city continues to provide ongoing engineering reports through AECOM.

We have a busy couple of days ahead. Live music is featured today at both Baileys Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Dane County Farmers Market at the capitol square or live music at Paddy Macs. Looking further ahead, the Ironman Wisconsin Loop Festival takes place in Verona on September 13th.
On September 10th, officers responded to a residence on Hunters Cove Way regarding a burglary, resulting in the arrest of a 19-year-old suspect for burglary and reckless endangerment.
Today's flavor of the day is Raspberry Cheesecake. The store is currently open and serving until 10:30 PM, so there is still plenty of time to stop by for a scoop.
